svg.title: Styled two-piece instrumentation chassis for industrial data acquisition
svg.desc: Original synthetic folded sheet-metal concept. Dimensions and bend intent are customer requirements, not a developed flat pattern or supplier-approved design.

g.text: Exploded concept: two independent bent parts; base tray + skirted removable lid
Base 430 x 250 x 80 outside; lid 434 x 254 with 18 skirts
Display/control cutouts: panel-cutouts.csv. Styling band is a finish proposal.
Styled two-piece instrumentation chassis for industrial data acquisition
ORIGINAL SYNTHETIC CONCEPT · units mm · not to scale · CAD must derive the developed flat pattern
